caption: Figure 6. Caribou dynamically determines the DP genera- tion trigger frequency with a token bucket algorithm. Blue signifies system components, violet condition checks, and yellow actions taken by the system.
subject: how Caribou's Deployment Manager decides, via a token-bucket check, whether and when to regenerate a workflow's deployment plan

groups.why_chosen: A token-bucket flowchart where every box's role (component / condition / action) is readable from one shared shape+colour code alone, with database cylinders hanging off the chain as side-cars.
groups.what_to_learn: Give every box one of three shape+colour roles (blue rounded = component, violet diamond = condition, tan dashed = action), and feed each side-car database with a dashed 'Update' arrow kept separate from its plain read arrow.
